svg.title: Azure redundancy scopes
svg.desc: Three side-by-side panels show redundancy scopes: rack-level redundancy with a Virtual Machine Scale Set that spreads virtual machines across two fault domains behind a load balancer, datacenter-level redundancy that spreads virtual machines across three availability zones behind a zone-redundant load balancer, and region-level redundancy that runs the application in two regions behind Azure Traffic Manager with a replication and failover path between the regions.
